title: Luminara Unduli
subtitle: Jedi
franchise: Star Wars: Attack of the Clones
description: Luminara Unduli was a revered Jedi who served in the Order during its final days. She accompanied her Padawan, Barriss Offee, to Geonosis in the first battle of the Clone Wars to rescue Obi-Wan Kenobi from the clutches of the Separatists, in addition to Anakin Skywalker and Padmé Amidala. As a Mirialan, she had green skin and bore her common markings of her people.
